title: Ordinary geometric node by its completed local ring
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $x\in X$. Define $\operatorname{IsOrdinaryNode}(\Omega,X,x)$ to mean that $x$ is closed [def-weil-closed-points] and that the completion of the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ at its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is isomorphic as a ring to $\Omega\llbracket u,v\rrbracket/(uv)$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. This is the existing completed-local-ring predicate; it supplies no field action on $X$ and requires no compatibility of the ring isomorphism with an additional field action.
